text:
maria: Heads up — sampleapp upload sometimes sends the same file twice after a 401 refresh. Only repro on Pixel 8 (Android 14).
kevin: I can repro. Retrofit call canceled -> retry -> multipart body not rewindable.
sophia: Could this be our Authenticator doing SharedPrefs writes on main thread? That blocked dispatcher in one trace.
maria: Repro steps: start upload, toggle airplane mode, restore, server returns 401, authenticator refreshes, request retried -> duplicate POST. Logs: `--> POST /v1/upload`, `<-- 401`, `auth refresh`, `--> POST /v1/upload (retry)`, `--> POST /v1/upload (duplicate)`.
kevin: Unit tests use buffered RequestBody so they hide the issue. Production counting sink closes after first write.
sophia: Short-term workaround: buffer multipart to file (yuck) or fail fast when body isn't repeatable. SDK could detect non-repeatable bodies and throw with actionable message.
ci-bot: CI: test build for branch maria/multipart-fix scheduled.
maria: I'll open RN issue and add minimal OkHttp-only repro. Thanks.
